_comment: E2 pinned encoder/numerics/device block - executable form of PREREGISTRATION_E2.md section 2 ('Encoders, numerics, and device pins'). Configs 1-9 carry the Paper A registry names VERBATIM (Falsifyer/experiments/factorial_pilot/encoders.py, reached via PAPER_A_REGISTRY per the harness/e1/encoder_sweep.py convention); config 10 (long-context nomic) is a NEW NAMED CONFIGURATION outside that registry, checkpoint revision pinned at tag time. E2 scores ride the pinned polaritycheck reference numerics carried from Paper A/E1 - NOT E3's fresh-fp32 regime (D4 ruling: 'gte/mxbai CPU-only per the parity ruling').
_admission: Before any shard is admitted, each GPU-assigned config re-passes the frozen-probe parity gate (cosine delta <= 1e-5 vs the pinned path; probe set = results/verification/h4_gpu_parity_probes.json extended with titrated-length probes at L in {64, 512, 4096}). Shards merge only through scripts/merge_shards.py --verify-config-hash; the hash block covers {checkpoint_sha_or_rev, device, dtype, sentence_transformers_version}. A device failure re-pins by dated amendment below the tag (E3 amendment A1 precedent).
registry: Paper A registry, verbatim names (harness/e1/encoder_sweep.py convention; PAPER_A_REGISTRY env-overridable)

dtype_policies.force-fp32: model.float() after load (the seven GPU configs + long-context nomic run fp32 on their pinned GPU)
dtype_policies.checkpoint-native: no cast: load exactly as the pinned Wu-CPU path loads (gte/mxbai are fp16-native and the pinned path computes them in fp16 - RUNBOOK parity lesson 2026-08-06; forcing a cast here could CHANGE the pinned numerics, so none is applied)

configs.name: nomic-embed-text-v1.5 MRL-256 [PRODUCTION PATH, search_document:]
configs.note: production router semantics implemented natively (search_document: prefix, truncate to 256 dims, renormalize); parity vs the audited MRLEmbeddingRouter path is enforced by the pre-admission probe gate, including the titrated-length probes which catch any window-semantics mismatch

configs.name: nomic-embed-text-v1.5 [clustering: — documented symmetric prefix]
configs.note: window left at the registry default (whatever sentence-transformers loads for this checkpoint = the e1 pinned behavior); realized-token tables at tag time record what that default is

configs.name: BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5

configs.numerics_regime: E2 fresh fp32 (amendment A1, 2026-08-11) — NOT the Paper A/E1 pinned path

configs.numerics_regime: E2 fresh fp32 (amendment A1, 2026-08-11) — NOT the Paper A/E1 pinned path

configs.revision_policy: TBD-AT-TAG: PREREGISTRATION_E2 section 2 pins this checkpoint revision at tag time; until it is written here the sweep resolves the local HF-cache snapshot sha and records it in the config-hash block (merge equality across shards then enforces a single snapshot)
configs.note: NEW NAMED CONFIGURATION outside the Paper A registry: long-context nomic at its full window (largest titrated bin is 4096; window headroom beyond that is reported as unused rather than promised). If the registry-default nomic already loads at 8192 the two configs coincide except for this explicit pin - the tag-time realized-token/window table discloses that.
